en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a central European town street scene. Tall, narrow townhouses line a curved street leading toward a large building with a prominent clock tower and ornate gables. In the foreground is a small square with bare trees and pedestrians, and part of a church-like building on the right edge. At the top left, printed text reads "Döbeln i. S.", and on a storefront at street level the sign "Max Albrecht" is visible.
